invariants.title: CPUID + OSXSAVE + XCR0[2:1] + Independent FMA Gating
invariants.proposition: AVX2_FMA backend execution is permitted if and only if CPUID leaf 1 OSXSAVE=1, XGETBV(0) bits [2:1]==0b11, CPUID.01H:ECX.AVX=1, CPUID.01H:ECX.FMA=1, and CPUID.07H(0):EBX.AVX2=1.
invariants.fail_closed_condition: Any simulated or physical hardware missing OSXSAVE, YMM state, AVX2, or FMA selects SCALAR_C99 under AUTO_FALLBACK or returns ZCC_STATUS_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_HW under EXACT_REQUIRED; zero AVX instructions execute.
invariants.verification_method: Unit tests injecting mocked zcc_cpu_caps_t masks + objdump ISA scan of portable .o files + mutation M_CAP_DROP_XCR0 & M_CAP_DROP_FMA.

invariants.title: Separate Compilation Unit ISA Isolation
invariants.proposition: Portable translation units (cpu_capabilities.c, compute_sha256.c, compute_scalar.c, compute_dispatch.c, compute_ptx.c, execution_receipt.c) are compiled with -mno-avx -mno-avx2 -mno-fma and contain zero VEX/EVEX AVX or FMA instructions.
invariants.fail_closed_condition: Presence of ymm/zmm registers or vfmadd/vaddps/vpadd* opcodes in portable .o disassembly blocks release.
invariants.verification_method: Automated objdump -d inspection executed during T21-G03 verification.

invariants.title: Scalar C99 Reference Correctness and Dual-Compiler Portability
invariants.proposition: Scalar C99 kernels compile cleanly with both GCC (-std=c99 -mno-avx -mno-avx2 -mno-fma) and ZCC (./zcc), matching an independent IEEE-754 float64 reference oracle within tight scalar tolerances.
invariants.fail_closed_condition: Compilation failure on either GCC or ZCC, or output divergence exceeding op tolerance bounds.
invariants.verification_method: Dual-compiler build + execution against Python float64 oracle.

invariants.title: Cross-Backend Differential Numerical Equivalence (Scalar, AVX2, PTX)
invariants.proposition: For all 13 Track 21A operations across normal, prime/boundary, non-contiguous stride, unaligned (+4/+8/+12), extreme-magnitude, and finite randomized inputs, Scalar C99, AVX2_FMA, and PTX_SM120 outputs agree with the independent FP64 oracle and each other within declared (atol, rtol, ulp) tolerances.
invariants.fail_closed_condition: Any backend exceeds tolerance bounds, crashes on unaligned/boundary sizes, or swaps backends silently when EXACT_REQUIRED is specified.

invariants.title: Quantization Block Format Parity (Q8_0, Q4_0, Q4_K)
invariants.proposition: Scalar, AVX2, and PTX quantization decoders implement identical GGUF byte layouts (Q8_0=34B/32, Q4_0=18B/32 split-half nibbles, Q4_K=144B/256 with 6-bit packed scales/mins) and reject non-divisible K fail-closed.
invariants.fail_closed_condition: Mismatch vs independent bit-exact Python decoder or acceptance of malformed K.
invariants.verification_method: Bitwise-exact Q8_0/Q4_0/Q4_K reference vectors + boundary invalid-K negative test.

invariants.title: Non-Finite IEEE-754 & Invalid Parameter Discipline
invariants.proposition: NaN and +/-Inf tensor elements propagate without SIGFPE or silent finite garbage; invalid ops, NaN/non-positive rmsnorm eps, negative strides, or rank out of [1..4] return explicit ZCC_STATUS_ERR_* codes.
invariants.fail_closed_condition: Zero return on invalid shape/eps/stride, process crash/SIGFPE, or corrupted finite result when input contains NaN.
invariants.verification_method: Adversarial edge test matrix in test_track21a_compute and differential_oracle.py.

invariants.title: Bounds, Overflow, Aliasing, Ownership & ASan/UBSan Safety
invariants.proposition: All array accesses are bounded by overflow-checked descriptor extents; ZCC_OWNER_READONLY outputs, overlapping buffers, null pointers, and OOM conditions fail cleanly with zero memory leaks or UB under -fsanitize=address,undefined.
invariants.fail_closed_condition: Any ASan/UBSan error, size_t overflow acceptance, or write to READONLY output.
invariants.verification_method: GCC -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all execution + OOM allocator fault injection.

invariants.title: Silent Failure Observatory Mutation Sensitivity
invariants.proposition: Controlled fault injections across arithmetic, tensor indexing, quantization decode, accumulation/norm precision, dispatch fallback, capability detection, receipt generation, and verifier authorization are detected and killed by the verification pipeline.
invariants.fail_closed_condition: Any injected mutant survives, or unknown failure signature is falsely relabeled as a known pass/match.

invariants.title: Defined Deterministic Replay Per Backend
invariants.proposition: Re-executing identical (inputs, kernel op, dtype, options, seed) repeatedly on the same backend and hardware produces identical status code and bitwise-identical output_buffer_sha256.
invariants.fail_closed_condition: Output SHA-256 differs between repeat executions of identical deterministic configuration.
invariants.verification_method: Multi-run SHA-256 comparison across SCALAR_C99, AVX2_FMA, and PTX_SM120.

invariants.title: Cryptographic SHA-256 Execution Receipt Tamper Detection
invariants.proposition: Execution receipts seal metadata, input descriptor/buffer digests, output digest, backend identity, hardware caps, and status using FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 (plus optional HMAC-SHA256 attestation) and label verification_status=UNVERIFIED_RUNTIME_ONLY at runtime.
invariants.fail_closed_condition: Independent verifier accepts tampered field/hash/schema or runtime self-certified PASS receipt.
invariants.verification_method: Receipt tamper negative control battery in tools/verify_track21a_release.py.

invariants.title: Independent Fail-Closed Release Authority & Non-Regression
invariants.proposition: Standalone verifier independently inspects artifact digests, ISA disassembly, differential/mutation/tamper evidence, verifier negative controls (--self-test), and existing compiler selfhost + differential non-regression before issuing PASS.
invariants.fail_closed_condition: Missing, stale, contradictory, self-certified, or unverified evidence returns non-zero exit status.

invariants.title: INV-RELEASE-CLOSURE (Tracked & Staged Deliverable Completeness)
invariants.proposition: Every required release deliverable (A_required <= A_release) is non-ignored in git, hashed in canonical release evidence, present in the exact staged candidate tree, and isolated from unrelated workspace modifications.
invariants.fail_closed_condition: Any required artifact is gitignored, missing from release evidence or git index, or accompanied by unexpected staged/unrelated files.
invariants.verification_method: tools/verify_track21a_release.py canonical manifest closure audit + --verify-staged git index check + isolated checkout reproduction.

invariants.title: INV-VERIFIER-PURITY (Protected Baseline State Invariance)
invariants.proposition: Verification-only commands MUST preserve protected baseline ledgers, compiler core sources, and unrelated workspace files identically across execution (S_before == S_after).
invariants.fail_closed_condition: Any verification run mutates BOOTSTRAP_BASELINES.tsv, part0_pp.c..part6_ptx.c, or unrelated files (observed historical defect DEFECT-T21A-VP01 in scripts/log_bootstrap_hash.sh --check).
invariants.verification_method: Pre/post SHA-256 snapshot comparison in tools/verify_track21a_release.py + negative self-test control.
